prayerExcerpt.en-US: "I long to suffer all imaginable pains, that souls may quickly see and praise their Redeemer."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Anseio por sofrer todas as dores imagináveis, para que as almas vejam e louvem prontamente o seu Redentor."

meta.face: A Florentine woman of about forty-five with a fair complexion and a natural HIGH COLOUR on the cheeks, and a BROAD, full, MOON-SHAPED face — WIDE, FLAT cheeks, a SHORT, broad nose with rounded, slightly FLARED nostrils, SMALL, WIDE-SET grey eyes under HEAVY upper lids, FAINT, thin brows set HIGH above them, a small, soft mouth with a full lower lip, just parted, and a soft, rounded chin; hair hidden by the white wimple and veil; a quiet, open gaze straight at us.
meta.basis: The portrait of 'B. Catherina de Ricciis Florentina' in the Museo Civico of Montepulciano, attributed on Commons to Giovanni Battista Naldini (1535–1591), her contemporary, shows a broad, flat-cheeked, high-coloured face with a short broad nose, small heavy-lidded grey eyes and a small parted mouth, in a white habit and white veil holding a book; the card follows it. Dates and Prato are from Wikipedia and the Catholic Encyclopedia. The white veil, the book and the broad face keep her apart from `catherine_siena`.
